TXT_APP_TAGLINE: A small corner for deep focus
TXT_PAGE_DESCRIPTION: Choose focus and break times that suit you, and give your attention to what you want to do.
TXT_RUNNING: The timer is running. Take it at your own pace.
TXT_PAUSED: Paused. Your remaining time stays the same.
TXT_STOP_DESCRIPTION: Time spent will be recorded in your history. The next session will start immediately.
TXT_RESET_CYCLE_DESCRIPTION: Progress in the current session won't be saved. The timer will return to the first focus session and wait for you to start. Your saved history will stay intact.
TXT_NO_CONFIG_DESCRIPTION: Create a configuration with focus and break times to get started.
TXT_MUSIC_DESCRIPTION: Choose a playlist to listen to during Pomodoro. Your timer works without music, too.
TXT_CONFIGS_DESCRIPTION: Save different focus and break times for studying, writing, or everyday work.
TXT_CONFIG_FORM_DESCRIPTION: Enter durations in minutes. Duration changes won't affect a running or paused session.
FOCUS_ROUNDS_LABEL: Focus sessions before a long break
MSG_NAME_REQUIRED: Enter a name between 1 and 120 characters.
MSG_MINUTE_RANGE: Enter a duration from 1 to 180 minutes.
TXT_DELETE_DESCRIPTION: This configuration will be deleted and can't be restored. Your previous session history will stay intact.
TXT_EMPTY_CONFIG_DESCRIPTION: Create your first configuration to begin a focus session.
TXT_HISTORY_DESCRIPTION: Review completed and early-ended focus and break sessions saved to your account.
TXT_EMPTY_HISTORY_DESCRIPTION: Try changing your filters. If you have no history yet, complete a session or end one early to record it here.
TXT_LOCAL_NOTE: Your timer progress is stored in this browser on this device.
TXT_SERVER_NOTE: Your configurations and history are saved to your account.
